title: Create-Borafied
description: A lightweight modpack focused on Create, Aeronautics, farming, and exploration.
body:
## A lightweight modpack focused on Create, Aeronautics, farming, and exploration.
Terralith, Tectonic, and a bunch of structure mods to make the world feel alive. Features Create and Aeronautics to fuel your creativity. Tons of Create structures to get you started with your Create shenanigans.
Has Farmer's Delight for cozy farming and cooking features. Also features Serene seasons for realistic crop yield and Slice and Dice for better compatibility with Create.
